SELECT DISTINCT s.spec,s.clause,p2.pack_number,p2.tsg_meeting FROM document d JOIN cr_in_pack c ON c.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=c.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section z ON z.cr=d.id JOIN section s ON s.id=z.section_id JOIN disposition x ON x.target=d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id=x.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id=r.meeting_id JOIN cr_modifies_section z2 ON z2.section_id=s.id JOIN document d2 ON d2.id=z2.cr AND d2.target_release=d.target_release JOIN cr_in_pack c2 ON c2.cr=d2.id JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id=c2.pack_id WHERE p.pack_number='RP-261275' AND m.wg='RAN5' AND x.evidence_status='source_verified' AND x.scope='whole_document' AND s.release=d.target_release AND p2.tsg_number<p.tsg_number AND p2.tsg_number=(SELECT MAX(p3.tsg_number) FROM cr_modifies_section z3 JOIN document d3 ON d3.id=z3.cr JOIN cr_in_pack c3 ON c3.cr=d3.id JOIN cr_pack p3 ON p3.id=c3.pack_id WHERE z3.section_id=s.id AND d3.target_release=d.target_release AND p3.tsg_number<p.tsg_number)

SELECT DISTINCT d.number,x.code,m.label,p.pack_number FROM document d JOIN disposition x ON x.target=d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id=x.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id=r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack c ON c.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=c.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section z ON z.cr=d.id JOIN section s ON s.id=z.section_id WHERE d.target_release='Rel-19' AND s.release='Rel-19' AND s.spec='38.521-4' AND s.clause='6.2A.3.1.1.3.3_1' AND m.wg='RAN5' AND x.evidence_status='source_verified' AND x.scope='whole_document'

SELECT DISTINCT s.clause,d.number,x.code,m.label,p.pack_number FROM document a JOIN cr_modifies_section za ON za.cr=a.id JOIN section s ON s.id=za.section_id JOIN cr_modifies_section z ON z.section_id=s.id JOIN document d ON d.id=z.cr JOIN disposition x ON x.target=d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id=x.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id=r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack c ON c.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=c.pack_id WHERE a.number='R5-186468' AND d.number<>a.number AND d.target_release='Rel-15' AND s.release='Rel-15' AND m.wg='RAN5' AND x.evidence_status='source_verified' AND x.scope='whole_document'

WITH RECURSIVE v(id) AS (SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier=(SELECT id FROM document WHERE number='R5-236866') UNION SELECT revision.later FROM revision JOIN v ON revision.earlier=v.id) SELECT DISTINCT d.number,x.code,p.pack_number FROM v JOIN document d ON d.id=v.id JOIN disposition x ON x.target=d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id=x.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id=r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack c ON c.cr=d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id=c.pack_id WHERE m.wg='RAN5' AND x.evidence_status='source_verified' AND x.scope='whole_document'
